note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training hyperparameters, model architecture, optimizer settings, data pipelines, and dataset configuration for the Sapiens 2B surface normal estimation model on the Render People dataset at 1024x768 resolution.
run_training: run the sapiens 2b normal estimation training using this MMSegmentation config file with mmengine runner
review_model_config: review the sapiens 2b VisionTransformer backbone and VitNormalHead decode head configuration for normal estimation
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and gradient clipping configuration
review_train_pipeline: review the training data augmentation pipeline including random resize, normal crop, and photometric distortion steps
review_dataset_config: review the NormalRenderPeopleDataset and NormalCombinedDataset configuration for synthetic render people training data
